title: Study abroad advising
summary: Choose a country, a school and a programme that fit your goals, grades and budget.
bodyHtml:
A counsellor looks at your grades, English level, budget and goals, then builds a shortlist with you.

What's included

  • Profile assessment and study plan
  • Shortlist of schools across countries
  • Application timeline and document checklist
  • Essay and personal statement review
  • Scholarship and financial aid search

How it works

  1. Book a free first consultation.
  2. Agree a plan and timeline with your counsellor.
  3. Work through each step together until you arrive.

title: Top university admissions
summary: Essays, activities and interview preparation for highly selective universities.
bodyHtml:
For students aiming at highly selective universities, we plan the application one to two years ahead.

What's included

  • Extracurricular and summer programme planning
  • Test planning (SAT, ACT, IELTS, TOEFL)
  • Essay brainstorming and editing
  • Interview practice
  • Early decision and early action strategy

How it works

  1. Book a free first consultation.
  2. Agree a plan and timeline with your counsellor.
  3. Work through each step together until you arrive.

title: Career and major orientation

title: Immigration and settlement
